Application.Text18:
observations:
id: O4
summary: PCW8.5 ACA/MCA显著扩展且前交通区域仍可见丛状结构；解释成年人变异属于形态学对应推断
source_locator: Results3.2; Fig5
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text19:

id: O5

source_locator: Results3.3; Fig6
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text20:
observations:
id: O6

source_locator: Results3.4; Fig7
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text21:

Application.Text22:

source_locator: Results3.9; Fig14-16
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text24:
